'''Soul Pact''' is a [[Dark Pact]] card.  It first appeared in [[The Lurker at the Threshold]] expansion.

==Card info==
When you gain a Soul Pact, restore your [[Sanity]] to full.

'''Any Phase''': While this card is refreshed, anytime you would gain any amount of Sanity, you may instead gain that amount of [[Power token|Power]].

You may spend a Power token as either a [[Clue token]] or as 1 [[Stamina]] when you suffer a Stamina loss.

'''[[Upkeep]]''': [[Exhaust]] Soul Pact and lose X Sanity to gain X Power.
